notes: Draft written by the build step; the manifest step confirms or replaces it. Sepolia (11155111). LumineonPriceFeed(address owner_, address attester_): owner_ is the requester's $owner and is the only wallet able to call approveRequest(bytes32,bytes32), which binds one actual oracle requestId to its questionHash after the owner checks that request's exact text and full policy (especially toleranceBps 0 and guards, which v2 does not sign); it cannot set or change a price. attester_ is IMD's attestation signer as reported by GET https://api.imd.fun/oracle/requests (field attester) on 2026-10-02 and recovered from a live signature in test/RealAttestationCompatibility.t.sol. The feed deploys with no price; the first observation arrives when a request made from docs/oracle-request-template.json (consumer = {11155111, feed address lowercase}, panel 20, quorum 14, toleranceBps 0, validForSeconds 86400) is attested, approved by the owner and relayed by anyone via submitAttestation. The factory supplies PoolInitializationGuard, LP and MerkleDistributor; the pool pairs lumi with native ETH and opens at the network's trading fee. LaunchToken has no constructor arguments and the feed never touches it.
